title: Panel widget line chart limits make it difficult to see how close line is to maximum
line: System Monitor line charts have a new "Show frame" option that draws a border around the chart, so in a panel you can see where the maximum is.
explanation: The Line Chart face's compact representation (used in panels) draws only the line and its fill, with no grid lines, axis labels or border, so nothing marks the top of the Y range and you can't tell how close a value is to the maximum. The face now has a "Show frame" option (Line Chart Details > Appearance, off by default) that draws a 1px border around the chart in both the panel and the expanded view, in the same separator colour as the grid lines.

commits.message:
Line Chart face: add an option to draw a frame around the chart

In a panel the line chart has no grid lines or axis, so there is nothing
showing where the top of the range is and it is hard to tell how close the
line is to the maximum. Add a "Show frame" option that draws a border.

BUG: 502431

patches.diff:
From 26c0e0dcb543e850c476b1bf44523b73b9c34074 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 18:15:09 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] Line Chart face: add an option to draw a frame around the
 chart

In a panel the line chart has no grid lines or axis, so there is nothing
showing where the top of the range is and it is hard to tell how close the
line is to the maximum. Add a "Show frame" option that draws a border.

BUG: 502431
---
 faces/facepackages/linechart/contents/config/main.xml  | 3 +++
 faces/facepackages/linechart/contents/ui/Config.qml    | 5 +++++
 faces/facepackages/linechart/contents/ui/LineChart.qml | 9 +++++++++
 3 files changed, 17 insertions(+)

diff --git a/faces/facepackages/linechart/contents/config/main.xml b/faces/facepackages/linechart/contents/config/main.xml
index 992bbc72..ab9f0a53 100644
--- a/faces/facepackages/linechart/contents/config/main.xml
+++ b/faces/facepackages/linechart/contents/config/main.xml
@@ -24,6 +24,9 @@
         <entry name="showYAxisLabels" type="Bool">
             <default>true</default>
         </entry>
+        <entry name="showFrame" type="Bool">
+            <default>false</default>
+        </entry>
         <entry name="rangeFromX" type="Int">
             <default>0</default>
         </entry>
diff --git a/faces/facepackages/linechart/contents/ui/Config.qml b/faces/facepackages/linechart/contents/ui/Config.qml
index 010206b8..e5b0251d 100644
--- a/faces/facepackages/linechart/contents/ui/Config.qml
+++ b/faces/facepackages/linechart/contents/ui/Config.qml
@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@ Kirigami.FormLayout {
     property alias cfg_lineChartSmooth: smoothCheckbox.checked
     property alias cfg_showGridLines: showGridLinesCheckbox.checked
     property alias cfg_showYAxisLabels: showYAxisLabelsCheckbox.checked
+    property alias cfg_showFrame: showFrameCheckbox.checked
 
     property alias cfg_rangeAutoY: rangeAutoYCheckbox.checked
     property alias cfg_rangeFromY: rangeFromYSpin.value
@@ -62,6 +63,10 @@ Kirigami.FormLayout {
         id: showYAxisLabelsCheckbox
         text: i18nc("@option:check", "Show Y axis labels")
     }
+    QQC2.CheckBox {
+        id: showFrameCheckbox
+        text: i18nc("@option:check", "Show frame")
+    }
     QQC2.SpinBox {
         id: fillOpacitySpin
         Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@label:spinbox", "Opacity of area below line:")
diff --git a/faces/facepackages/linechart/contents/ui/LineChart.qml b/faces/facepackages/linechart/contents/ui/LineChart.qml
index 3d25f3bd..7bc61769 100644
--- a/faces/facepackages/linechart/contents/ui/LineChart.qml
+++ b/faces/facepackages/linechart/contents/ui/LineChart.qml
@@ -49,6 +49,15 @@ Charts.LineChart {
             || stackedAuto && yRange.from == yRange.to
     }
 
+    Rectangle {
+        anchors.fill: parent
+        visible: chart.controller.faceConfiguration.showFrame
+        color: "transparent"
+        border.width: 1
+        // The same color as a Kirigami.Separator
+        border.color: Kirigami.ColorUtils.linearInterpolation(Kirigami.Theme.backgroundColor, Kirigami.Theme.textColor, 0.2)
+    }
+
     Sensors.SensorDataModel {
         id: sensorsModel
         sensors: chart.controller.highPrioritySensorIds
--

media.caption: Pure master: Total CPU Use as a line chart in the panel; nothing shows where 100% is
With "Show frame" on: the border marks 0% and 100%, so the peaks can be judged against the maximum
The new "Show frame" checkbox in the widget's Line Chart Details page
Expanded popup with the frame on: the border lines up with the 0% and 100% grid lines
